name: r59-portfolio-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Photographer Portfolio (Frontend, Admin, and Cloudflare Workers Backend)

scripts.build: pnpm run build:frontend && pnpm run build:backend
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --dir frontend run typecheck && pnpm --dir backend run typecheck && pnpm --dir admin exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
